adversarial_audit.objection: Use a noncovariant measurement to evade Fourier fibers.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Coherent random-shift symmetrization preserves average success and remains an accessible standard circuit.

adversarial_audit.objection: Use higher-rank effects so outcome garbage depends on the input.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Only the matching known-state garbage direction is needed; cleaning it extracts E_d psi_d/sqrt(p) exactly.

adversarial_audit.objection: The extracted filter may vanish on many target residues.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Per-target success may vanish, but its uniform-legal average is at least the claimed decoding success. The theorem does not falsely claim a per-target guarantee.

adversarial_audit.objection: Uniform-legal targets are not the standard planted inversion law.
adversarial_audit.resolution: A direct weighted Cauchy--Schwarz inequality gives planted success at least (N/L)p, without transferring through uniform-legal targets.

adversarial_audit.objection: The proof assumes the PGM or rank-one completeness.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Neither is used. Positivity, exact POVM completeness, covariant symmetrization, and accessible dilation suffice.

adversarial_audit.objection: All input states lie in the uniform-fiber span, so the physical inverse stays there.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False. Full-space effects can leak from that span. The counterexample gives target-zero witness 00 with probability one instead of a uniform 00/11 superposition. The repaired proof needs only fiber support.

adversarial_audit.objection: This proves no efficient DCP measurement exists.
adversarial_audit.resolution: No. It proves that such a measurement would constitute an average subset-sum witness procedure under a fixed-label success promise, not a hardness theorem or a new algorithm.

adversarial_audit.objection: Call the circuit an approximate PGM to evade exactness.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The reduction never compares it with the PGM. It applies to the circuit's actual effects and actual decoding success; only wrapper synthesis error is charged by a hybrid bound.

claim_gate.reason: For an accessible state-only decoder/inverse, unamplified compute-copy-uncompute prepares a witness-supported state, not a uniform fiber. Both target laws have success >=(N/L)p^2, and label-averaged success is >=pbar^2 without estimating p. The optional normalized variant gives (N/L)p with bootstrap cost. No new solver, hardness claim, independent review, or per-target guarantee is supplied.

falsifiers_triggered: The earlier inference from arbitrary physical effects to UNIFORM fiber preparation is false; its full-space counterexample is retained.
Initial noncovariance is removable without average-success loss by an accessible coherent symmetrization.
The cleaned correct branch need not be a full POVM; its Fourier-diagonal inverse already suffices on average.
Planted witness success is bounded directly by (N/L)p for every label tuple; an occupancy theorem is unnecessary for this step.
Approximation to a named ideal POVM is not a loophole because the executed circuit has exact effects.
The repaired reduction is not an entanglement lower bound for uniform-fiber preparation and must not inherit those exclusions.

proof_obligations.resolution: A coherent random cyclic shift makes every correct branch have the original average success and preserves circuit access.
Bootstrapped matching garbage gives eta_d=E_d psi_d/sqrt(p) for any effect rank.
Cyclic covariance separates full residue eigenspaces. The inverse heralds P_s eta_0/||P_s eta_0||, not necessarily the uniform fiber.
Cauchy--Schwarz gives average heralding probability at least p, with no fiber-occupancy regularity assumption.
Weighted Cauchy--Schwarz gives E_planted q_s>=(N/L)p>=p for every label tuple, without a density-one or occupancy assumption.
The executed reversible decoder defines an exact POVM. A hybrid over O(p^-1/2 log(1/epsilon)) wrapper calls preserves at least 3p/4 success at inverse-polynomial gate precision.
REFUTED in general: the exact two-qubit counterexample leaves the uniform-fiber span. Only witness support is guaranteed.
The unamplified compute-copy-uncompute wrapper works at every p including zero and gives q-average>=p^2. Jensen yields label-average witness success>=pbar^2 without estimating p or selecting labels.
The bootstrap uses the implemented dilation and its inverse; a physical environment that cannot be retained or reversed is outside the standard quantum-circuit model.

summary: Repaired the arbitrary-measurement reduction in the full assignment space: a physical inverse need not prepare a uniform fiber, but supports valid target witnesses. An unamplified compute-copy-uncompute wrapper gives planted and uniform-legal success >=pbar^2 over any public-label law, with two decoder/inverse calls and no success estimation or occupancy assumption. Review pending.
